column1: 5.5.4.2.21 Help Menu. Help menu (as shown in Figure-5.233) shall include GUI controls
for displaying SCD application related help. The help document shall display description of
SCD application functionalities (in SCD Main Window) for configuring & controlling the EW
system. The help document shall include GUI snap shots of relevant functionalities in SCD
Main Window with content indexing and keyword search.
